title: Rabbi Eleazar ben Chaggai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shekalim 7:2, where he was supporting Rabbi Mana. Hyman identifies the Rabbi Mana in this passage as the second Rabbi Mana.

notes.text: The exact force of מסמיך, and thus the physical or institutional relationship, needs checking. The earlier passive “supported by Rabbi Mana” is not established by the causative wording.

The saved named Guggenheimer Shekalim 7:2 paragraph has Elazar son of Chaggai supporting Rabbi Mana and then observing an Aramean cutting from his horse. The scene supports an ordinary physical-support reading; it does not state an ordination. “As they walked” is not an explicit phrase and is not added. The identification as the second Mana belongs to Hyman.

Hyman’s printed heading (vol. I, p. 175) is Rabbi Eleazar ben Chaggai. In the consulted Yerushalmi Shekalim 7:2, Eleazar is supporting Rabbi Mana when he sees an Aramean cutting from his horse. The action is described in the immediate scene. The numbering of Rabbi Mana belongs to Hyman’s account.
